key_findings: Model at MAP level, not match level. Map win rate x veto is the dominant feature for CS2/Valorant/R6.

THE BINDING CONSTRAINT: required sample (20-30 maps per map) exceeds roster stability for all but tier-1 teams, and patch cadence (LoL/Valorant ~2 weeks) invalidates history faster still. Hierarchical partial pooling with time decay and roster-overlap weighting is mandatory, not optional.
LAN and online must be separate rating pools - online rating overstates LAN for many rosters.
Pistol-round and first-blood are the noisiest inputs (~2 pistols per map). Tiebreakers only, smallest stakes.
Recent form should use exponential decay (45-60d half-life), not 'last 5'.
